Core Bus Tools (tools.rs)
• stream: create | list
• subscription: create | recover | delete | list
• publish: payload, from, to, ack (atomic tx)
• receive: handle, ack, wait: bool (no timers)
Flat action enum + per-action descriptions

div.div:
BearerAuthenticator & RequestLog Middleware (auth.rs, request_log.rs)
• Constant-time SHA-256 comparison against loaded token digests on every HTTP request
• Optional structured JSONL request log (--request-log) recording method, route, status, and principal
• rmcp 3.1.4 Streamable HTTP config with sse_keep_alive: None and sse_retry: None

div.div:
Event Signals & Process-Local Wait Observation (signals.rs :: Signals)
• commits: per-stream tokio::sync::watch<u64>; wake means check stored state again
• owners: per-subscription generation; newer receive supersedes; deletion wakes waiter
• WaitGuard: enter / drop updates waiting and active-count watch channel
• waiting is instantaneous, not a durable reservation or proof remote client is alive

display: inline-block; font-size: 12px; font-family: Helvetica; color: light-dark(#000000, var(--ge-light-color, #ffffff)); line-height: 1.2; pointer-events: all; white-space: normal; word-wrap: normal;

div.div:
QueueStore Trait & Bundled SQLite Store (store.rs :: QueueStore / Mutex<Store>)
• Atomic commands: create_stream, claim/recover/delete_subscription, follow_stream, ensure_subscription
• publish + ack & admit / select: idempotency, self-echo suppression, direct addressing, batch sealing
• QueueStore::release (Store::release): rechecks subscription + owner_generation before recording attempt;
• Delivery queries: read_inbox, read_description, pending_description

rect.style: fill: light-dark(rgb(209, 250, 229), rgb(4, 39, 21)); stroke: light-dark(rgb(5, 150, 105), rgb(42, 167, 128));

div.div:
QueueReader Trait & Bundled SQLite Reader (store.rs :: QueueReader / Mutex<Reader>)
read-only snapshot queries (SQLITE_OPEN_READ_ONLY | SQLITE_OPEN_NO_MUTEX) — never blocks writer:
• list_streams & list_subscriptions (live roster + metadata + last_active_at + waiting)
• agent_binding, inbox_unread, and inbox for /mcp/agent/{agent} & inbox resources

div.div:
minymaton-storage-check & storage.json (deploy/)
systemd .timer checks statvfs available blocks on DB volume;
records state in fixed-size storage.json slot & posts edge-triggered
alert when free space < 10% via curl --config - (URL on stdin)
